The verdict (no moralising)

Bottini publishes its rate. Petro doesn't. If you live in the Hudson Valley overlap, Bottini's transparency plus the 2026-27 Mid-Hudson group-buy cap at $4.399/gal beats any quote-only black box on transparency alone. Outside Bottini's footprint, Petro is one of the few options at scale, but get multiple quotes.

FAQ

Is Bottini cheaper than Petro?
Bottini publishes its rate. Petro doesn't, so its delivered price cannot be verified before you enroll. Bottini's 2026-27 Mid-Hudson group-buy cap ceiling sits at $4.399/gal (plus a $0.35/gal enrollment cost). The published-vs-quote-only gap is the central tradeoff.
Which serves NY better?
Both serve NY. Bottini is Hudson Valley specific. Petro covers Long Island, NYC, and the wider tri-state.
